skills.name: Transform Claw
lines: Earth type magic attack on all enemies (XL)
* 1-3 Additional same attacks based on number of of Spirits of the Rabbit stacked
** Upon usage of skill, all Spirits of the Rabbit will be consumed
* Increased damage according to the user's remaining MP value after using this skill
** XL[150%] + 250% × (1 - Remaining MP/Maximum MP)2
* Maximum 1x Attack multiplier at 47>0 MP is 400%
* Maximum Skill multiplier at 3 Spirits of the Rabbit stacks is 4 x 400%
